name: Ready Made Plastic Trays
old_description: Businesses have trusted our genuine, American-made trays since 1990.
about:
Founded in 1990 in Meridian, Idaho, Ready Made Plastic Trays operates as a licensed and certified thermoform plastic tray manufacturer serving businesses and the public. The company has built its reputation on American-made trays for packaging and storage applications.

The company manufactures high-precision trays using High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS), offering food-grade, medical-grade, and anti-static variants in stock configurations with round, square, or rectangular pockets. An in-house CNC tooling shop supports custom fixture design up to two inches deep, enabling tailored solutions for complex component shapes. Both stock and custom orders are fulfilled with domestic and international shipping.

Customers span aerospace, automotive, dental, electronics, firearms, food and beverage, machining, manufacturing, medical, optical, medical devices, and mechanical sectors. The firm highlights long-term relationships with clients in medical device shipping and aerospace component protection.

Ready Made emphasizes domestically sourced materials traceable to original manufacturers, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a no-nonsense ordering process with volume discounts. The company attributes its longevity to rapid production turnaround and a commitment to personal service, with customers noting consistent delivery since 2009.
